farwatch_officer: Outrider Kelsara, commanding Far Watch Post. We hold the road where it bends east toward Durotar. The Kolkar test this palisade every week, and they're massing at Mor'shan Base Camp, far to the north-west.
morshan_outrider: Dask, Warsong Outriders. This is Mor'shan Base Camp, and it's Kolkar ground more nights than it's ours - their scouts ring it and their siege lines are going up. We don't rest easy this far from Orgrimmar.
nb_road_warden: Hargak Ironvein, warden of the Gold Road. My road, my rules. The bandits working this stretch have started collecting a toll of their own, and I mean to close their books.
nb_coast_sergeant: Beachmaster Kizzle Fuseblast, Steamwheedle. Welcome to the Merchant Coast! Mind the crabs, the Southsea pirates, and their cannon. In that order. Ratchet's a long way south if you'd rather not.
nb_oasis_scout: Mahri Dustwalker, scout. That's the Stagnant Oasis just north-east of us, and don't drink from it - I wish I were joking. The Kolkar have made camp on it, and their hounds aren't as picky as you.
nb_rampart_captain: Captain Korvash Gatebreaker. Behind me, the Mor'shan Rampart. Beyond it, Ashenvale and the night elves. Their sentinels have been probing the wall for a month. Choose a side quickly.
nb_dryhills_huntress: Zan'ula Skyshard. I hunt da Dry Hills - you be standin' in dem. Hush, mon. Da hills have ears and da Witchwing harpies have eyes. Mostly eyes. Mostly hungry.
nb_hollow_shaman: Earthcaller Rohna Skyhorn. The cave behind me is Serena's Hollow, and the harpies who nest in it have been raiding down from their roost. The earth is crying out, child. I'd like you to make it stop.
nb_fen_warden: Dugmok Mudhoof, fenwarden. The Slug Fens start just west of where you're standing. Everything in them is slow, wet and hungry. Welcome. You'll fit right in.
nb_sludge_inspector: Nix Cogsprocket. I used to work for the Venture Company. Used to. That's their rig in the Sludge Fen, east of here, and now I watch them work from a safe distance. With a very large wrench.
nb_lode_surveyor: Gruda Deepdelve, claim-surveyor. The Boulder Lode Mine - the shaft just north-east - is the Horde's by right and by paperwork. The Venture Company has the pickaxes. I have the stubborn.
